title: Removed links
intro: Restore a context link without copying or changing either object. Only links with live, accessible endpoints and an editable source appear here.
emptyDescription: Recover deleted objects from Trash first. An equivalent active link cannot be recovered twice.
recovered: Link recovered. Neither canonical object was changed.
recoveringVersion: Recovering link version {version}. Content and permissions stay unchanged.
refreshNote: Close this preview and refresh the Event before trying again.
